decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message INTRODUCE recording the panel reset connection and on-board-only BOOT button policy.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY containing all GPIO assignments specified for the panel buttons, slide switch, and touch inputs.
The panel-control inventory does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module family or module model.
The EN-to-GND statement describes the panel reset connection, not the separate 5V_EN boost-control signal, so the boost-rail state remains unchanged.
The listed panel controls do not alter the charge-status display method, charge LED connector, or associated circuit values.
The source lists panel-control connectors and does not change the power-board interconnect references, types, pinout, or pin-order policy.
Panel buttons, reset, and touch controls do not change the sensor board's role as a connector fanout for external sensors.
The source does not change the addressable LED type, data GPIO, supply, level shifting, or standby power control.
The panel-control connector list has no effect on the battery NTC connector or thermal-protection behavior.
The source concerns main-board panel controls and does not change power-board battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
Identifying the BOOT button as on-board and development-only does not change the USB data lines or the USB-C programming-port role.
The panel-control inventory does not affect I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable constraints, bus speed, or signal topology.
